evals.prompt: Create a short, bright "coin pickup" sound effect for the game and render it to a WAV file so the user can listen to it. It must work with the game's existing default audio pipeline.
evals.expected_output: A song module in src/audio/songs/ containing a valid SoundBox song object using only sine oscillators (simple-player compatible), rendered to a non-silent WAV of a few seconds via the project's own player (scripts/render-song.mjs), with correct render stats reported.
assertions: A song source file with a valid SoundBox song object (songData, rowLen, patternLen, endPattern, numChannels) was created
A rendered .wav exists and is non-silent (peak > 0)
Instrument waveforms i[0] and i[4] are 0 (sine), so the default simple player reproduces the designed sound
The rendered sound is short (<= 4 seconds), appropriate for a pickup sfx
The render was produced through the project's own player (render-song.mjs or direct use of small-player*.ts), not an unrelated synthesis approach
